headline: Chennai Petroleum shares jump 5% on strong Q2 profit and dividend
hook: Profit triples alongside a chunky dividend payout
summary: Chennai Petroleum reported a profit after tax of ₹2,271 crore for the second quarter of FY27, marking a 210 percent increase compared to ₹732 crore in the corresponding quarter last year. Retail investors holding shares benefit from both the earnings growth and the cash payout.
